cs.t: I'm using Nexx WT3020  https://wiki.openwrt.org/toh/nexx/wt3020  for my easy VPN project, but I've got the GL-iNet in mind also. The idea of these is to connect them to your main router and have a "protected Wi-Fi network" that routes all traffic through VPN, while you can always go back to your normal Wi-Fi network to not use VPN. If anyone's interested in talking about it, hit me up at hello@tscr.io
